name: Love You To Pieces
source:
A deranged drag queen, "Tara Heart", leaves a trail of brutal slayings leading up to Valentine's Day, where she terrorizes a group of friends attending Seattle Technical University.

[From [url=https://soulsoftea.itch.io/lytp]itch.io[/url]]
